chapter: Cage on work songs, church and social life
title: Coon John rhythm and waltzes
summary: Cage knows a little about Coon John and plays some waltzes.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Mm-mm. That's Staffly. Did you ever hear of a Coon John? I did. I am, but I don't know much about it. I don't either. What is it? It's a kind of a rhythm. I think a dance and a rhythm.
They used to play on the piano sometimes. You know. And what about waltzes? You play many waltzes? Yeah, I know. That's a lot of them. What are some of the waltzes you play?
I used to play over the way. I play a hip-hop, but I don't know what it was. Mm-mm. I just play my song.
